articles.title: After Jamui, another girl molested on camera in Bihar; 4 nabbed
articles.description: In Samastipur, four men were arrested after a video surfaced showing them allegedly harassing a girl in public. The incident occurred on Dam Bypass Road when the girl and a boy stopped to take photographs. Similar incidents had recently taken place in Jamui, where a Class X girl faced harassment from a group of youths. The Jamui police detained three minors and identified more suspects from video footage.

articles.title: Stock market today: Sensex tumbles 550 points, Nifty50 slips below 23,300
articles.full_text: Indian shares are set to open lower on Thursday after oil prices climbed above $100 a barrel in the previous session, following Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian's comments at the UN General Assembly that Tehran would not surrender to US pressure. Iran and the United States remain divided over how to end their war, although diplomacy must continue, a senior Iranian official told Reuters on Wednesday. The elevated oil prices are likely to weigh on investor sentiment and raise concerns over inflation and corporate costs. GIFT Nifty futures were at 23,270 points as of 8:02 am IST, indicating a negative start for the benchmark Nifty 50 index. Oil prices edge lower as Iran keeps door open to diplomacy Oil prices edged lower on Thursday after rising about 4% in the previous session, as investors assessed signs that Iran remained open to diplomacy to end its war with the US, although the two sides remain far apart on the terms of a possible agreement. At 7:30 am IST, WTI crude was trading at $91.87 per barrel, down 0.32%, while Brent crude was at $102.53 per barrel, lower by 0.54%. Japan's 10-year government bond yield jumped 8 basis points to 3.06%, its highest level since August 1996, after Tokyo markets reopened following a three-day holiday. The 30-year yield rose 5.5 basis points to 4.12%. The US 10-year Treasury yield held at 5.11% after touching its highest level since 2007 overnight. Rising yields reflect expectations that central banks may keep rates higher to tackle persistent inflation. Asian equities were mixed on Thursday as investors weighed persistent Middle East tensions, higher-for-longer interest rates and the prospect of an extension to the US-China trade truce. Japan's Nikkei 225 rose 1.73%, while the MSCI Asia ex-Japan index declined 0.64%. Australia's S&P/ASX 200 fell 1.2% to a more than three-month low. Investors were also watching US-China talks, with Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent saying Washington and Beijing had reached a deal to extend their 11-month trade truce as US President Donald Trump personally greeted Chinese President Xi Jinping at Joint Base Andrews.

articles.description: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback. With a remarkable twelve-hour battery life on a single charge, this device empowers users with greater independence. The project's goal is to enhance the day-to-day experiences of those with vision impairments.

articles.title: The Paradise Movie Review and Release Live Updates
articles.full_text: The initial social media responses to 'The Paradise' remain mixed. Some viewers have praised Nani, the visuals, performances and emotional sequences. Others have criticized the screenplay, editing, sound mixing and second-half narration. With the film now entering its theatrical run, these contrasting early reactions have become a major part of the conversation around Nani's latest release. 'The Paradise' will have its theatrical release on Thursday, September 24. Srikanth Odela has directed the film, while Nani leads the cast as Jadal. With paid premieres already underway and advance bookings crossing Rs 40 cr, the film enters its release day with substantial pre-release activity. While the pre-release numbers point to strong demand, the final opening-day collection will depend on additional bookings and actual occupancy. The film's performance across Telugu states, North America and other markets will also contribute to its overall theatrical run. The combination of substantial advance bookings and paid premieres has created significant interest around the film's opening. The movie has already crossed Rs 40 cr in advance sales when block seats are included. The current opening-day bookings stand at Rs 19.92 cr. Hyderabad alone has contributed Rs 7.47 cr to the advance collection. Dulquer Salmaan also extended his support to Nani ahead of the release. The actor shared a message on X on Wednesday. Dulquer Salmaan said he is always rooting for Nani and expressed his excitement about watching 'The Paradise'. He also wished Nani and the entire team massive success. Sundeep Kishan  addressed director Srikanth Odela in his X message. He expressed excitement about the filmmaker's work on the project. "Dear @odela_srikanth, excited for/of /by you and your madness. Wishing Dear @anirudhofficial, @11Lohar and the entire team of Favs a massive success," he wrote. Actor-producer Sundeep Kishan also wished Nani and the team before the release. He shared his message on X ahead of the film's theatrical debut. Sundeep Kishan wrote, "Wishing Dear @NameisNani Boy only the very Best for Tomorrow .. praying for your inspiring passion to win Big Time." Vijay Deverakonda continued his message by expressing his hopes for the film and Telugu cinema. "Wishing the team 'all glory', he added, "May Telugu cinema continue to grow leaps and bounds, and may we keep telling stories that are bold, rooted and uniquely our own." Vijay Deverakonda also sent his wishes to the 'The Paradise' team ahead of its release. On Wednesday, the actor posted a message on X. He wrote, "Wishing the entire team of #TheParadise - @NameisNani, @odela_srikanth and the incredible big cast of the film all the very best for its release tonight. The songs have become personal favourites, and I’m really looking forward to a film rooted in the courage and revolutionary spirit of Telangana - a story that feels deeply personal to all of us." As the paid premieres began, reactions to 'The Paradise' started appearing on X. One viewer described the movie as a below-average entertainer. The viewer wrote, "The first half was at least passable, but the second half was completely flat and travels elsewhere throughout the film !! Even Anirudh's background in the 2nd half didn't work (sic)," the post said. Raghav Juyal is part of the cast in a key role. His presence adds another prominent name to the film's ensemble. The movie also features veteran actor Mohan Babu and Kayadu Lohar in important roles. Nani plays Jadal in 'The Paradise'. His character belongs to a marginalised community in 1980s Secunderabad. The story follows his circumstances and the challenges surrounding his community. The narrative is built around themes of survival and resistance. 'The Paradise' marks Nani's second collaboration with director Srikanth Odela. The two previously worked together on 'Dasara'. Their latest film takes a different setting and explores a story centred on oppression, survival and the struggle for basic rights. 'The Paradise' began its paid premiere screenings on Wednesday evening. The early shows allow audiences to watch the movie before its regular Thursday release. The premiere response could also influence the film's subsequent theatrical performance. However, the final opening-day numbers will depend on bookings and occupancy across the remaining shows. The film has also registered notable interest in the North American market. The overseas response adds another component to its pre-release momentum. With bookings continuing across markets, the final advance collection could move higher before the film opens. If the reviews are positive, 'The Paradise' could be an all time blockbuster. The advance-booking trend indicates substantial demand in Telugu-speaking territories. Telangana and Andhra Pradesh are contributing significantly to the movie's pre-release sales. The response from these markets is particularly important because of the film's setting and story. 'The Paradise' is rooted in the culture and social history of Telangana. 'The Paradise' has received an 'A' certificate from the Central Board of Film Certification. The certification restricts the film's theatrical audience to adults. Despite the certification, the movie has continued to record substantial advance bookings. The response has been particularly notable across its core Telugu markets. Hyderabad has recorded the highest contribution to the film's advance sales so far. The city has generated Rs 7.47 cr in bookings. The strong response from Hyderabad adds to the film's momentum in the Telugu-speaking markets. Telangana and Andhra Pradesh are among the major contributors to the early sales. The opening day has emerged as the biggest contributor to the film's current advance sales. Thursday, September 24, has already generated Rs 19.92 cr through advance bookings. The film has also received an 'A' certificate from the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC). Despite the certification, advance sales have remained strong across several key markets. Paid premiere shows for 'The Paradise' began on Wednesday evening. The early screenings are expected to give the film an opportunity to build momentum before its first regular shows on Thursday.

articles.title: Sam Smith and Normani’s plea to drop the ‘Dancing with a Stranger’ lawsuit rejected
articles.description: The hit collaboration between Sam Smith and Normani, 'Dancing with a Stranger', is entangled in a renewed legal battle as the previous dismissal of a lawsuit has been overturned. A federal judge has decided that the case merits a jury trial to examine the aspects of originality in the song’s composition. Released in 2019, the track notably climbed to No. 7 on the Billboard Hot 100, signifying its widespread acclaim.

articles.title: Hayley Williams talks about her ex, Chad Gilbert
articles.description: In a heartfelt tribute, Hayley Williams reminisced about her almost decade-long relationship with Chad Gilbert, who recently succumbed to brain cancer. Williams conveyed deep appreciation for the musical journey they embarked on together and the cultural influence he had on her life. She celebrated Gilbert's impactful contributions to the music industry and expressed her heartfelt condolences to his family and friends, emphasizing the meaningful bond they shared.
